summary.free_volume_definition: union of sampled sensor rays at 0.5m voxel resolution, 1Hz/1024 endpoints/12m range; observation proxy, not ground truth

comparison.scope: Same CMU indoor/start/limits/metric definitions, individual unpaired runs with different trajectories and ROS/GPU scheduling. Values interpolate ~0.5s samples at exactly 300/600s. No extrapolation past the actual 300s baseline. Sampled free volume is an observation proxy, not ground-truth coverage. Sampled zero-command intervals are not exact command timing.

progress_diagnosis.scope: Post-hoc stage diagnosis. Movement and observed-volume growth are separate proxies. Path_found means a local template was available under HT checks; it does not prove progress to a global exploration objective. Group rejection counts include evaluated alternatives and can exceed event counts; they are not counts of stops. Global-goal cause requires a separate investigation.

10 inhibitors listed.

slow_frame_host_evidence.scope: post-callback OS report, not a frequency trace or a proven cause

diagnostics.scope: Recovery movement only spans each EXECUTING start to its first COMPLETED event. No simulated/fixture movement is included.

command_audit.scope: Exact recorded neural map at each command audit timestamp, recorded reaction plus bounded-braking body-yaw sweep (legacy records use their constant 1s sweep), 0.5 threshold, physical footprint, context and 1-second TTL. Confirms command gate; does not establish learned model ground-truth accuracy.

published_match_original.scope: Equal linear/angular values within 1e-7, nearby bag receipt within 100ms; odometry-header lag is recorded separately, not used to reject velocity associations. Every matched accepted candidate has been checked independently against its exact HT map by COMMAND_AUDIT.json. Receipt proximity does not uniquely identify a publish when identical velocities repeat.

output_boundary_supplement.scope: Keep original output-header and audit-control windows and receipts. Supplement only boundary associations with equal v/w within 1e-7 and receipt within 100ms, then independently check their exact original-map reaction/braking sweep at actual control time. No performance-window extension. Receipt association need not be unique for repeated equal velocities.

source_contract.scope: Read-only inspection of all recorded source maps with source stamp inside the measurement window. Counts are map-cell observations across frames, not unique terrain cells. Total variance remains available; HT intentionally uses observation_variance with the accepted height/time. End snapshot uses the last recorded HT map, not necessarily the exact final command map; exact command validation is separate.

interruption.written_by: post-reboot recovery audit; original runner did not finish
interruption.parsing: NUL bytes removed in memory only; raw file preserved

interrupted_attempt.scope: Interrupted trial only. Raw NULs removed in memory for diagnostic parsing. No bag recovery, completed-duration claim or performance acceptance. System suspend/clock jump, GPU kernel errors and host reboot evidence remain separate original logs.

budget.scope: User-requested one 600s repeat of the previous frozen height-quality candidate. A second attempt only for a demonstrated infrastructure failure. No navigation optimization, Release, hardware or raw-data cleanup.
budget.reason: User-requested one complete 600s repeat obtained on the second infrastructure attempt. Interrupted first trial retained. Stop; no further candidate or formal launch.
